title: Polls of a group
summary: The polls of a group, open and ended, newest first (bipe-chat/bipe#669). Opens from group-details.

totalVotes.description: bipe_app_poll_votes. Absent while results are hidden (undisclosed and open).

leader.description: The answer with the most votes, with bipe_app_poll_most_votes, when results are visible and a vote exists.

polls.description: From Room.timelineWithConfiguration with focus live and a TimelineEventFilter that includes the poll start event type. Newest first. The list loads more at its end.

appear.effect: Builds the timeline and back-paginates until 20 polls or the start of the group.

loadMore.effect: At the end of the list: one more back-pagination.

notes: Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#669): a row shows the poll and its result and has no tap, because voting and ending happen in the chat (poll-detail), which group-details does not hold. mz can overrule.
